summary: Shared with You surfaces links and files that people received in Messages, Mail and FaceTime in a system shelf, and adds collaboration hooks for those services. BifrOSt has no Messages, Mail or FaceTime, so the shelf and its collaboration hooks have no counterpart. The generic share sheet is covered under sharing, not here.

features.note: no shelf fed by a messaging service; springboard/sdk/src/share.rs covers sending and receiving only

features.apple: highlights and attribution views for participants
Messages and FaceTime collaboration, CloudKit and iCloud Drive
features.note: BifrOSt Cloud (~/Projects/bifrost-cloud) has accounts and sync, but no collaboration service
